fixed_execution.limit_reference: last closed Gate 15m close plus/minus 0.20%, nearest price tick

classification: Use only completed hourly closes. Signed ER over 24h and 120h must both meet 0.20 and 0.10 in the same direction for a trend. Both below threshold means range. Other combinations are transition.
entry_notes: The three regimes use distinct signal schedules. Range divergence compares confirmed price swings with MACD(12,26,9) histogram extremes within each leg. Two closed candles on each side, adjacent swings within 32 candles, active for up to 32 candles unless broken. Same direction MA5/MA20 and histogram confirm the reversal. A pattern is used on its first eligible close. In trend the breakout level is a confirmed 1h pivot known at the start of the signal candle; the retest is within 32 candles and the confirmation within four. Confirmed real November signals are checked at their reported signal timestamps only.

baseline.description: The prior Gate compression-expansion entry in all regimes.

range_double_trend_retest.description: Range: double divergence with MA5/MA20 and MACD direction. Trend: break and retest the confirmed hourly level. Transition: wait.

range_triple_trend_retest.description: Range: triple divergence with MA5/MA20 and MACD direction. Trend: same break and retest. Transition: wait.

range_double_trend_level_or_volume.description: Range: double divergence. Trend: MA5/MA20 cross within 1% of confirmed hourly support/resistance, or a directional 8-hour breakout on at least 1.5x the past 20-bar median volume. Transition: wait.

range_double_trend_retest_transition_ori.description: Same range and trend rules as range_double_trend_retest. Transition: use the original compression-expansion entry.

range_original_trend_level_or_volume.description: Range: original compression-expansion entry, with same-direction divergence recorded as confluence. Trend: level or volume entry. Transition: wait.
